newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-West Australia police launch sea search for four people.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-West Australia police launch sea search for four people.

text.p: Western Australian police said on Tuesday they had launched a search for four people, including a 14-year-old boy, who were one day overdue from a fishing trip off the southwest coast.
Bunbury police district superintendent John Watson told Reuters that a combined air/sea search was underway.
"The group went fishing at 0500 yesterday about 20 miles off Cape Naturaliste (about 260 km southwest of Perth) and were due back at 1100 hours," he said.
"They were reported missing at 1720. A plane from the police air wing is searching and four vessels as well. A second aircraft is up there too," Watson said.
He said conditions in the search region were very rough.
Names of the missing people have not been released.
